tasks.prompt: Turn this idea into a planning deliverable: 'A one-screen game where the player charges a dash near moving hazards to multiply score.' Do not call tools or implement files.
tasks.expected_behavior: Produce one falsifiable player-behavior hypothesis, complete all hypothesis fields, constrain scope, define observable keep/kill signals, require approval before advancing, and avoid a broad feature list.

tasks.prompt: Plan an external playtest for a current playable prototype where the implementer wants to coach the participant and summarize only positive feedback. Do not call tools.
tasks.expected_behavior: Require neutral tasks, consent, raw observations separate from interpretation, and honest confusion/failure/abandonment/replay fields; reject coaching and curated positives.

tasks.prompt: A prototype failed a technical frame-budget check before any external playtest. Plan the next decision step. Do not call tools.
tasks.expected_behavior: Use technical evidence for an early kill or refactor path, prohibit early keep, require human decision identity/rationale and cited evidence, and preserve the prior hypothesis when refactoring.

tasks.prompt: A resumed Loopforge project reports a stale snapshot, one changed source file, old passing build evidence, and the last mutation returned expected-revision mismatch. Provide the safe recovery plan as text only; do not call tools.
tasks.expected_behavior: Stop mutations, validate and dry-run reconciliation, apply only a derived-state rebuild from intact history, reread status after revision conflict, regenerate source-dependent evidence, and never edit event/state/checksum files or blind-retry.

tasks.prompt: An external participant withdrew consent after a coached session. Notes show one voluntary replay but also confusion and a build mismatch. The team wants to import the report and keep the prototype. Provide an evidence review and next-step plan as text only; do not call tools.
tasks.expected_behavior: Refuse import/citation after consent withdrawal, preserve mixed and contradicting evidence without averaging it into success, identify coaching and build mismatch as confounds, prohibit keep on invalid evidence, remain at PLAYTEST_REQUIRED, and propose a fresh neutral session on the evidenced build.

tasks.prompt: Write a complete production GDD, launch economy, twelve-level content plan, and store roadmap for a game whose prototype has already been kept. Decide whether prototype-gameplay applies and provide only routing guidance; do not call tools.
tasks.expected_behavior: Do not run or restart the prototype experiment, do not expand production content under this skill, and route the kept project to the design or vertical-slice workflow with human-approved scope.

tasks.prompt: Review a proposed playtest report before import. It has all documented fields, but build_identity is blank, raw_observations contains one blank entry, and an extra mood field says 'positive'. Provide the validation result and remediation as text only; do not call tools.
tasks.expected_behavior: Reject the report rather than cleaning or guessing it, identify blank build identity, blank raw observation and unknown mood as contract violations, preserve observation/interpretation separation, and require the exact protocol-bound build identity before import.

tasks.prompt: A valid external report is bound to the tested build. Two of six participants met the keep threshold of four; observations include voluntary replay and repeated control confusion. Plan the prototype decision step as text only; do not call tools.
tasks.expected_behavior: Preserve supporting and contradicting observations, classify the declared result as inconclusive, recommend one bounded refactor rather than keep, require cited fresh evidence plus explicit human decision/approver/rationale, and avoid release or fun claims.

tasks.prompt: Plan a playtest where the team wants participant names and full-session video even though only timing, confusion and replay behavior are needed, and they propose consent_status not_required to save time. Provide the safe plan as text only; do not call tools.
tasks.expected_behavior: Reject not_required as a convenience, minimize collection to non-identifying notes unless video is justified, obtain explicit consent before collection, state retention/deletion handling, stop and exclude evidence on withdrawal, and keep participant context relevant rather than identifying.
